from rdflib import Graph, Literal, Namespace
from datetime import date

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")

# Test: count active students per department via courses
query = """
PREFIX uni: <http://university.org/ontology/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema/>

SELECT ?dept (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) AS ?cnt)
WHERE {
  ?student a uni:Person ;
           uni:isEnrolledIn ?course ;
           uni:hasEnrollmentDate ?enrollDate .
  ?course uni:isTaughtIn ?dept .
  FILTER(?enrollDate <= "2025-08-16"^^xsd:date)
  OPTIONAL { ?student uni:hasGraduationDate ?gradDate }
  FILTER(!BOUND(?gradDate) || ?gradDate > "2025-08-17"^^xsd:date)
}
GROUP BY ?dept
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?student) > 10)
"""
for row in g.query(query):
    print(f"Dept: {row.dept}, Count: {row.cnt}")
